component.name: ZERAVRIX
component.summary: High-Performance Native Manga, Manhua and Manhwa Reader for PC

description.p: ZERAVRIX is an ultra-fast, native desktop application engineered specifically for reading Manga, Manhua, and Manhwa on PC. Built with Kotlin, Compose for Desktop, and hardware-accelerated Skia rendering, it delivers an uncompromising reading experience.

ul.li: Continuous Multi-Chapter Reader with seamless infinite scrolling and automatic boundary transition.
Optimized Memory Governor: keeps RAM strictly bounded (under 500 MB) with intelligent page preloading (5 ahead, 3 behind).
Single-Page and Overhauled Two-Page reading modes with effective screen space utilization and gutter dividers.
Hardware-accelerated Image Adjustments: Contrast, Saturation, Brightness, and Invert Colors (Night Mode).
Full Arabic catalog and global source support with right-click source pinning.
13 authentic studio color schemes including true AMOLED Void pitch-black OLED support.
F11 Fullscreen support and effortless wheel scrolling anywhere on canvas.
Strict RAM and memory optimization (bounded <= 500MB window preloading: 5 ahead, 3 behind).
Two-Page reading mode overhaul with proper scaling and screen space utilization.
Hardware-accelerated image adjustment controls: Saturation, Contrast, Brightness, and Invert Colors.
Canvas-wide scrolling without requiring cursor over images.
Source browsing navigation fix: preserved scroll position and state when returning from manga details.
Reading History set as default landing view.

description.p: Release 1.7.1: Continuous multi-chapter reader, next-chapter prefetch, and LRU cache.
